description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
